clinical.citation: The 12q14 microdeletion syndrome: six new cases confirming the role of HMGA2 in growth (PMID: 21267005)

variants.description: 12q14 interstitial microdeletions (within a 12q13.3q15 range) encompassing LEMD3 and HMGA2; exact breakpoints not given in the abstract
phenotypes: congenital heart defects (in the overall 6-patient series)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Array-detected 12q14 deletions, 4 of 6 confirmed de novo in the series. Short stature was attributed to HMGA2 deletion. LEMD3 deletion did not produce osteopoikilosis in the two patients whose deletions included it.
clinical.center_country: Three diagnostic testing centres (country not stated in abstract)

model_organism.citation: LEMD3 organizes the 3D chromatin architecture to maintain vascular smooth muscle cell identity (PMID: 41044070)
phenotypes: Lemd3 deficiency in VSMCs causes loss of the contractile phenotype
disturbed chromatin structure with increased inter-TAD interactions at A/B compartment boundaries
repressed expression of VSMC contractile genes

model_organism.citation: Perturbations of BMP/TGF-β and VEGF/VEGFR signalling pathways in non-syndromic sporadic brain arteriovenous malformations (BAVM) (PMID: 30120215)
phenotypes: A transgenic zebrafish model was used to functionally validate the pathogenic variants, including a damaging LEMD3 variant found in a BAVM patient
The abstract does not give the specific zebrafish phenotypes or whether knockdown or variant overexpression was used

model_organism.citation: Hellemans et al. 2004 - Loss-of-function mutations in LEMD3 result in osteopoikilosis, Buschke-Ollendorff syndrome and melorheostosis (PMID: 15489854)
phenotypes: XMAN1, the Xenopus laevis ortholog of LEMD3, antagonizes BMP signaling during embryogenesis
This is prior work cited in the abstract; the Xenopus experiments were not performed in this study, and the study itself reports human LEMD3 loss-of-function mutations

biological.citation: 2025 - The inner nuclear membrane protein LEMD3 organizes the 3D chromatin architecture to maintain vascular smooth muscle cell identity (PMID: 41044070)
biological.summary: A genome-scale CRISPR screen identified LEMD3 as a regulator of VSMC identity. Lemd3 deficiency caused loss of the contractile phenotype and worsened intimal hyperplasia in mice. Lemd3 depletion increased inter-TAD interactions at A/B compartment boundaries, reduced chromatin accessibility and repressed contractile gene expression.

biological.citation: 2025 - The inner nuclear membrane protein LEMD3 organizes the 3D chromatin architecture to maintain vascular smooth muscle cell identity (PMID: 41044070) [protein interactome]
biological.summary: Protein interactome analysis showed LEMD3 interacts with CBX3 (HP1γ), a reader of H3K9me2/3. This interaction anchors heterochromatin at the nuclear periphery.

biological.citation: Hsa_circ_0070963 inhibits liver fibrosis via regulation of miR-223-3p and LEMD3 (PMID: 32003753)
biological.summary: LEMD3 is a validated target of miR-223-3p (luciferase reporter and rescue experiments) and is responsible for hepatic stellate cell activation. The hsa_circ_0070963/miR-223-3p/LEMD3 axis regulates HSC activation in vitro and in vivo. Hsa_circ_0070963 acts as a miR-223-3p sponge, and its levels fall during liver fibrosis.

biological.citation: Identification of unique venous thromboembolism-susceptibility variants in African-Americans (PMID: 28203683)
biological.summary: In a GWAS of VTE in African-Americans, the intragenic LEMD3 SNP rs138916004 reached genome-wide significance. The SNP is present only in Africans. LEMD3 was also differentially expressed in GEO and Mayo Clinic expression datasets. LEMD3 encodes an antagonist of TGF-β-induced proliferation arrest.

biological.citation: LEM-domain proteins are lost during human spermiogenesis but BAF and BAF-L persist (PMID: 28684548)
biological.summary: RT-PCR, immunofluorescence and western blotting showed LEMD3 is absent in human spermatids, as are Emerin and LBR. LEMD1, LEMD2 short isoform, ANKLE2, LAP2β, BAF and BAF-L are present. The lamina-chromatin interface in spermatids therefore differs from that in somatic cells.

biological.citation: The heterozygous Lemd3 +/GT mouse is not a murine model for osteopoikilosis in humans (PMID: 19862465)
biological.summary: Heterozygous Lemd3 gene-trap mice showed no osteopoikilosis-like lesions on X-ray, microCT or histology, and no significant differences in bone histomorphometric parameters. LEMD3 is described as an inner nuclear membrane protein that antagonizes BMP/TGFβ signaling via R-SMADs. Haploinsufficiency in mouse does not reproduce the human bone phenotype.

biological.citation: Deactivating germline mutations in LEMD3 cause osteopoikilosis and Buschke-Ollendorff syndrome, but not sporadic melorheostosis (PMID: 17087626)
biological.summary: Heterozygous loss-of-function LEMD3 mutations (p.L478X, p.Y441X, frameshift c.332_333insTC, p.R655X) were found in familial OPK and BOS, including a case with melorheostosis-like lesions. No mutations were found in sporadic melorheostosis.

biological.citation: Germline LEMD3 mutations are rare in sporadic patients with isolated melorheostosis (PMID: 16470551)
biological.summary: Seven novel LEMD3 loss-of-function mutations were identified in OPK/BOS patients, including families with BOS and melorheostosis. No germline or somatic mosaic LEMD3 mutations were found in most sporadic isolated melorheostosis.
biological.sample_size: 5 OPK/BOS probands, 2 BOS-melorheostosis families, 12 isolated melorheostosis patients

biological.citation: Identification of a novel LEMD3 Y871X mutation in a three-generation family with osteopoikilosis and review of the literature (PMID: 26694706)
biological.summary: A novel heterozygous frameshift c.2612_2613insA (p.Y871X) in exon 13 of LEMD3 co-segregated with osteopoikilosis across three generations and was absent in controls. It is predicted to cause a premature stop codon.

biological.citation: ASHG 2011 - A novel mutation in the gene LEMD3 in a patient with sub-clinical Osteopoikilosis
biological.summary: A heterozygous missense variant (R901W, c.2701C>T) in the C-terminal nucleoplasmic region of LEMD3 segregated with sub-clinical osteopoikilosis in an Azorean family. This region (aa 789-911) is predicted to be a U2AF homology motif (RRM-like) protein-interaction domain.
